name: Simple Correspondence Analysis (CA)
when_to_use: Two categorical variables (two-way contingency table); association tested by chi-square before generating the perceptual map.

expected_input.question: What is the association between two categorical variables?

plain_explanation.purpose: Shows on a map the relationship between two categories of a count table (who 'goes with' whom).
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you have two categorical variables (e.g., region x product) and want to see associations visually.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A table of counts crossing two categorical variables.
plain_explanation.example: See which regions buy more of which product types, on a single map.
plain_explanation.diagram: Rows and columns become points on the same plane; close points = strong association
